This infobox is for [[Force power]]s. See also: [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide|Layout Guide]] for [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe#Force power articles|Force power articles]].

===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{ForcePower
|image=
|name=
|alternate=
|alignment=
|area=
|purpose=
|inventor=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

==Infobox fields==
*<code>image</code> &ndash; Link an image that represents the power.
*<code>name</code> &ndash; The name of the power. For powers with multiple names, put only the primary name here.
*<code>alternate</code> &ndash; For powers with multiple names, put the alternative name(s).
*<code>alignment</code> &ndash; If the power is aligned with either the [[Light side of the Force|light side]] or [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]], put that alignment. If neither, leave blank.
*<code>area</code> &ndash; For [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]], this is for those explicitly categorized in one or more areas of [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] ([[Alter (Jedi Order)|Alter]], [[Control]], [[Sense]]) or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ([[Body]], [[Mind]], [[Offense]]) studies. Be careful not to assume it belongs in an area. For more than one area, use separate lines prefaced with <code>*</code>. Leave blank for [[canon]] articles.
*<code>purpose</code> &ndash; Briefly summarize the purpose of the power.
*<code>inventor</code> &ndash; If the power was explicitly invented, name the inventor(s).
*<code>affiliation</code> &ndash; If the power is associated one or more groups, name them and use separate lines prefaced with <code>*</code> for multiple affiliations.
</noinclude>
